title: Embeddings get an API and three models
summary:
Embeddings gained an API, Seedance gained more ways to make video, and BYOP apps gained developer earnings.

Added OpenAI-compatible `/v1/embeddings` and an embedding-model listing, with Gemini Embedding 2 and two OpenAI embedding models. Requests can batch up to 32 text inputs; Gemini also accepts image, audio and video content parts. `openai-3-small` is the default when no model is specified, while `gemini-2` requires a paid balance.

Added the paid-only `seedance-2.0` video model for text-to-video, a starting image, first-and-last-frame interpolation, or multiple reference images. It supports 4–15-second 720p clips, optional native audio and eight aspect ratios.

App Key owners can enable developer earnings for BYOP apps, with the share disclosed on consent screens and credited to the owner's wallet. The dashboard also keeps ordinary publishable API keys separate from App keys, so app-only settings appear where they belong.

daily.title: Embeddings via the API
daily.text: Send text or batches of up to 32 inputs to the OpenAI-compatible `/v1/embeddings` endpoint. Choose output dimensions within your model's limits. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

daily.title: Gemini Embedding 2
daily.text: Use `gemini-2` to embed text, images, audio or video content parts. It requires a paid balance. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=gemini-2).

daily.title: OpenAI embedding models
daily.text: Choose `openai-3-small` or `openai-3-large` for text embeddings. `openai-3-small` is the default for `/v1/embeddings` when you omit `model`. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

daily.title: Seedance 2.0 video
daily.text: Generate 4–15-second 720p videos with `seedance-2.0` from text, a starting image, first and last frames, or multiple reference images. Optional native audio is supported. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=seedance-2.0).

daily.title: Earnings for BYOP apps
daily.text: App Key owners can enable developer earnings for BYOP apps when creating or editing a key. Users see the developer's share on the consent screen. [Manage API keys](https://enter.pollinations.ai/keys).
